devops-bot: Starting deploy to prod: tag v2.8.1-migration. Commits: 3f1a9c -> 5b7e2d. Change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Migrations queued: 2026_03_add_email_index, 2026_03_user_flags_backfill
maya: Confirming canary on 2% of routes; watching metrics. Notify DB team if replica lag > 120s.
alex: I'll watch. Background index on users(email) — using CONCURRENTLY, but still writes WAL. Expected run ~ 30-90s typical.
devops-bot: Migration job started: add_index_users_email (job id mj-4421) on primary. Logs:
```
[INFO] starting index creation CONCURRENTLY on users(email)
[INFO] estimated rows: 24M
[INFO] initial index build: 0%...25%...50%...
```
devops-bot: Replica lag watch: primary->replica lag = 32s
jasper: Perf note: if lag climbs >120s, we should pause to avoid breaking read-heavy services.
kelly: Seeing a spike in read errors on reporting, could be connected.
devops-bot: Replica lag = 185s, pause trigger hit. Pausing migration job mj-4421. Error: replica_lag_threshold_exceeded
alex: Aha. Concurrent index still ships WAL; replicas falling behind. Recommend abort and rollback index job. We can re-run during low traffic.
maya: Agreed. We need to rollback the deploy and pin previous tag. Do we have a warm fallback?
release-bot: Rollback playbook started by maya. Steps: 1) abort migration mj-4421 2) pin tag v2.8.0 3) redeploy v2.8.0 4) validate health.
kelly: Commands to run in sequence:
```
redwood deploy migration abort --job mj-4421 --env prod
redwood deploy rollback --to-tag v2.8.0 --env prod --reason "replica lag during index"
```
devops-bot: Migration aborted: mj-4421. Status: aborted. Cleanup: leftover temp indexes scheduled for drop.
release-bot: Rolling back to v2.8.0 — start.
devops-bot: Deploy rollback finished: tag v2.8.0 now active in prod. All routes switched. Health checks: OK (95/95 checks passed)
jasper: Can we schedule the index during the next change window and run it on a replica first? Or consider pg_repack for online op? We'll add a runbook.
alex: We'll rework index to a partitioned/backfill approach and aim for low-traffic window. Filing follow-up ticket: ENG-6543
maya: Thanks team. I'll update release notes and notify customer ops. :white_check_mark:
devops-bot: Thread closed: deploy rolled back, migration aborted. Logs stored at: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/mj-4421
